title: 4/10 the Fly migration instance posted picks to the public Bluesky feed as a second production bot (shadow_mode never read)
tier_reason: a non-production instance delivered picks on the public delivery channel alongside the Pi5 production scheduler (delivery-contract impact); whether its picks differed from production's is not evidenced

contract.text: During the migration's parallel run only the production instance posts; an instance configured with shadow_mode = true saves picks locally and never posts.
contract.source: d5e0d7b 'add shadow_mode to scheduler for parallel-run validation'; scripts/fly-entrypoint.sh (0e6b598) writes shadow_mode = true; 5075fba body

mechanism.text: the Fly entrypoint wrote shadow_mode = true into the [scheduler] config and ran bts schedule, but run_day never read shadow_mode, so all three post_to_bluesky call sites (lock, in-loop fallback, final fallback) posted

verified_recovered.how: 634768e body: on 4/11 Fly ran with shadow_mode=true and save_pick wrote bluesky_posted=False (no post)

residual.text: result replies were suppressed only indirectly (a shadow-mode pick has no bluesky_uri); the flag was renamed private_mode on 4/12 (0cc7f23); the Fly deploy workflow and artifacts were removed (ecab05c 4/11, e997155 4/12) — whether the Fly machine itself was stopped is not evidenced

watchdog.trigger: more than one pick post (or pick DM) for the same date from the bot account, or a delivery written by a host other than the production host
watchdog.recovery_assertion: exactly one delivered pick per date, written by the production host

evidence.what: 'CRITICAL FIX: shadow_mode config was set but never read by the scheduler. The Fly machine was posting to Bluesky as a second production instance'; all three post_to_bluesky call sites now check shadow_mode
